1. (Currently Amended) A method of providing information regarding a product, the method comprising: receiving a unique identifier identifying a package containing a product, wherein the unique identifier is stored on at least one of the package, an identification card, or a user information medium; and generating at least use information based at least partially on stored user information regarding past use of the product.

19. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 1, wherein the unique identifier comprises a first unique identifier associated with a package, the method further comprising: reading a second unique identifier identifying a user providing the product to the package.

23. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 1, wherein generating the at least use information comprises generating the at least use information customized to the identified role of the user providing the product to the package. 

24. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 1, wherein generating the at least use information comprises generating the at least use information of a type customized for a user that interacts with the package. 

27. (Currently Amended) A system for providing information regarding a product, the system comprising: a user device configured to receive a unique identifier identifying a package containing a product and generate at least use information based at least partially on stored user information regarding past use of the product associated with the unique identifier, wherein the user device further communicates with a data store that stores the user information regarding past use of the product in association with the unique identifier, and at least part of the at least use information.
